meta.name: META4PRO Black Gold Voltage
meta.description: Mobile-first esports campaign built from real club photography, signal-yellow lacquer, black-gold acrylic and short energetic feedback.

primary.role: selected states, calls to action and campaign fields

secondary.role: page ground and high-contrast plate faces

accent.role: hot edge, focus ring and electric highlight

neutral.usage: near-black stages, graphite depth, muted metal copy and warm-white text

color.contrast_strategy: near-black and warm-white body contrast; solid yellow means selected or actionable

typography.font_style_notes: Oswald is reserved for compressed campaign statements, Onest carries UI and data, Unbounded appears only in the META4PRO wordmark.

spacing.section_rhythm: large campaign scenes separated by clamp(86px, 18vw, 190px), with tight 10-14px component clusters

layout.grid_system: mobile single-flow; authored asymmetric desktop composition
layout.columns: 1 on mobile, contextual 2-12 column compositions from 720px

elevation.shadow_style: offset soft black weight plus bounded gold emission
elevation.depth_cues: overlap, image scale, acrylic transparency, beveled edges and directed light

iconography.style: simple Lucide outline icons plus authored lightning assets

motion.entrance_pattern: short edge charge followed by a 16px directional settle
motion.philosophy: Energetic feedback, never continuous spectacle: transform and opacity on touch, richer pointer response only on fine pointers.

components.button_style: 66px minimum chamfered yellow or graphite plate with immediate press compression
components.card_style: full electric chamfer, real photography and black-gold face
components.navigation_pattern: five safe-area-aware bottom pills on mobile; open header navigation on desktop
components.list_style: native horizontal scroll-snap rails or authored vertical data plates
components.component_notes: Do not introduce generic rounded cards, decorative glass panels or rasterized UI text.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: an electrified black-and-gold esports campaign poster
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary gaming broadcast graphics and dimensional outdoor advertising

visual_language.ornamentation: decorative but bounded to lightning, acrylic and chrome
visual_language.whitespace_usage: large scene breaks with dense local groups
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: oversized type and one dimensional object balanced by real photography
visual_language.texture_usage: real club imagery, glossy acrylic and metallic raster surfaces

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast, color weight and deliberate overlap
composition.flow_direction: vertical campaign flow with horizontal swipe moments
composition.grouping_strategy: each section is a distinct authored scene
composition.negative_space_role: black breathing room isolates bright objects and data

imagery.photo_treatment: real club photography at natural brightness with restrained warm-yellow grading
imagery.illustration_style: transparent photoreal black-gold acrylic and chrome props
imagery.graphic_elements: lightning, diagonal lacquer fields and beveled electric contours
imagery.pattern_usage: no generic grids; only subject-specific electric lines

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: subtle lift or image scale on fine pointers only
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: medium; only selection, swipe and primary actions move

overview.fallback_strategy: static acrylic assets, native swipe and immediate state changes on reduced motion or coarse pointers
overview.primary_technology: CSS, semantic React and native scroll-snap

background_effects.description: static gold light fields with a fine-pointer spotlight in the hero

particle_systems.description: No particles on the production surface.

3d_elements.description: Acrylic MP, chrome and device objects are transparent WebP assets moved with CSS; no main-page WebGL runtime.

params.materials: black acrylic, gold edge and chrome

cursor_effects.description: The hero light and dimensional rasters react only to a fine mouse pointer.

image_effects.description: Zone photography acknowledges selection; galleries use native scroll-snap.

canvas_drawings.description: No canvas loop on the production page.

svg_animations.description: Lightning remains a static authored asset.

visual_effects.composite_notes: The authored moment is tariff switching: a short electric trace leads four staggered price plates. Zone selection receives one contour charge. Mobile uses native swipe and no parallax, blur, canvas or WebGL.
